column1: # title: Table 250.66 Grounding Electrode Conductor for ac Systems
# note: 1. If multiple sets of service-entrance conductors connect directly to a service drop
column5: the equivalent size of the largest service-entrance conductor shall be determined by the largest sum of the areas of the corresponding conductors of each set.

column1: # note: 2. If there are no service-entrance conductors
column2: the grounding electrode conductor size shall be determined by the equivalent size of the largest service-entrance conductor required for the load to be served.
